# no-space-in-links

- ID: `MD039`
- Category: Links and images
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `whitespace`, `links`

Link text has no spaces just inside its brackets.

## Why

The spaces end up inside the rendered link, where they serve no purpose.

## Options

This rule has no options.

## Fix

The fix deletes the spaces. gomdlint reports some links without a fix, such as
one whose text ends in a line break. gomdlint may report a finding without a fix
when the fix would change a line with one character in brackets, such as \[x\]
or \[1\], or the lines around it up to a blank line, because it could add or
remove a task list checkbox.

## Configure

Under `rules`, `no-space-in-links: false` turns the rule off and
`no-space-in-links: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable no-space-in-links` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line no-space-in-links -->
```
